definition: Elapsed time from a named public preclinical report or demonstration to a documented human milestone. This starts at the selected report date; earlier experimental work may predate it.
scope: Selected device lineages retain their species, date precision, and temporary-placement versus implant endpoints. Fieldwide acceleration and a pooled median remain unmeasured by this sample.

intervals.label: Neurotrophic cone electrode

quotes: Long-term recording of stable action potentials with a new electrode configuration has been achieved for up to 15 months in monkeys.

intervals.context: 1998-06-01 is publication, not first implant; 1996-12-04 is first listed NE implantation. Earlier rat work is acknowledged in the author methods paper, so 1992 is not established as first animal work.

intervals.label: Utah / BrainGate · Blackrock lineage

quotes: Here we show how activity from a few (7–30) MI neurons can be decoded into a signal that a monkey is able to use immediately to move a computer cursor
who implanted the first BrainGate device in June.

intervals.context: Keep BrainGate scope; 2002 is selected functional publication, not established first animal-event date or first-ever intracortical array. Blackrock is this lineage, not a second modern independent transition.

intervals.label: Synchron · Stentrode

quotes: demonstrate neural recordings in freely moving sheep for up to 190 d.
He received the Stentrode implant in August 2019.
He was the first patient enrolled in the first Stentrode clinical study

intervals.context: First implant August 2019, not September announcement; preclinical paper publication is not animal experiment date.

intervals.label: Neuralink · N1 / Link
intervals.species: macaque for selected Pager demo; earlier rodent/pig work acknowledged

report.basis: public demonstration/disclosure; current page metadata April 18; historical April 8 conflict not resolved

quotes: In January 2024, Noland became the first person to receive a Neuralink implant.

intervals.context: Do not silently promote April 8 to settled event date. Current metadata April 18; first implant primary evidence month-only; earlier 2019 rodent and 2020 pig disclosures invalidate a generic first-animal-2021 claim.

intervals.label: Precision · Layer 7

report.basis: v1 preprint publication; original PDF verified, not shared API abstract
quotes: regions in both hemispheres of the Göttingen minipig brain simultaneously

human.basis: temporary intraoperative placement, not chronic assistive implantation
quotes: Since the first procedure, completed in mid-April at the RNI
the Layer 7 Cortical Interface was temporarily placed on the brain of a patient undergoing resection of a brain tumor.

intervals.context: The human endpoint is temporary intraoperative placement in mid-April 2023. Original preprint January 2, 2022 reports minipig recordings. Month precision is retained for the human date; no chronic implant endpoint is inferred.

additionalPathways.label: Science · cortical Biohybrid
additionalPathways.note: The reviewed sources establish a mouse optical-stimulation study and a planned transition toward human patients. A completed cortical biohybrid human endpoint remains unverified in this review.

additionalPathways.label: Science · PRIMA
additionalPathways.note: PRIMA is a retinal prosthesis inherited from the Stanford/Pixium lineage. Human use preceded Science’s acquisition. December 2017 implantation month is inferred from the issuer’s January 2018 activation report. Earliest in-vivo preclinical milestone remains unresolved.

additionalPathways.label: Paradromics · Connexus
additionalPathways.note: The issuer reports nearly three years of same-device preclinical work before the temporary human procedure. Exact first preclinical event and surgery dates remain unspecified; temporary and long-term milestones remain distinct.
